meta.title: A $15 Payday Loan Fee Is Actually a 391% Interest Rate
meta.hook: A payday loan fee can look like fifteen dollars. Annualized, that's close to 400% interest.
meta.description: Payday loans are typically marketed as a flat fee, such as $15 per $100 borrowed, but they're usually due in about two weeks. Annualized the way other credit products are required to disclose, that works out to roughly 391% APR, per Consumer Financial Protection Bureau data — and borrowers who can't repay often roll the loan over, paying the fee again.
